# Sectra med rapport – allokeringschefen om långräntorna

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-04  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

SEB allocation chief Carl Hammer says rising long-term yields reflect a strong investment boom (AI, infrastructure, defence, renewables) and strong corporate earnings, not an immediate threat. SEB keeps a clear equity overweight but warns sentiment is stretched, a Fed hike may come as early as September, and a slowdown becomes more likely in 2027-28. The episode's main company story is Sectra's report: revenue up about 25% and cloud recurring revenue up 75%, while order intake fell about 46%. Sectra rose roughly 5% at the open, alongside several analyst rating changes (Note upgraded by SEB, Goldman Sachs changes on telecom stocks).

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SECT-B — Sectra | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong Q1: revenue +25%, cloud recurring revenue +75%, 19.8% margin. Stock up ~5% on the report. Order drop explained as a tough comparison.

#### Reasoning

The shift to services smooths revenue between quarters. Cloud recurring revenue is growing 75%, driven by rollouts in the US, Canada and the UK. The CEO says book-to-bill is still good despite orders falling 46.6% against a very strong Q1 last year. AI is positioned as a long-term tailwind through the Oxipit purchase. The market reacted positively (+3-5%). This view comes from the report and the CEO interview, not an explicit host recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake keeps falling beyond a tough comparison
- if cloud recurring revenue growth slows sharply
- if European cloud adoption stays stalled

> *"Det var ett bra kvartal. För att vara första kvartal var det väldigt bra."*

---

### 🟢 NOTE — Note | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst view: SEB upgraded Note to buy; the stock rose nearly 5%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited SEB analyst upgrade, not the hosts' own view. No reasoning for the upgrade was given in the episode.

#### Sell Triggers

- if SEB reverses the recommendation
- if the gain after the upgrade fades

> *"Vi noterar att Note är upp närmare 5 %. höjer SEB bolaget till köp i en förändrad rekommendation."*

---

### 🟢 VOD — Vodafone | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst view: Goldman Sachs double-upgraded Vodafone from sell to buy.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited Goldman Sachs upgrade by two steps, from sell to buy. The episode gave no reasoning beyond the rating change.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Goldman Sachs reverses the rating

> *"Samtidigt höjer Goldman Sachs Vodafone till köp från sälj."*

---

### 🟡 TEL — Telenor | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cited analyst view: Goldman Sachs downgraded Telenor to neutral.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited Goldman Sachs downgrade to neutral. No further details were given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further downgrades follow

> *"Goldman Sachs sänker Telenor till neutral"*

---

### 🟠 EOLU-B — Eolus | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Sold a mid-stage US solar and battery project for about USD 6.5M; stock up ~1%.

#### Reasoning

The sale of a US project shows Eolus can turn its project portfolio into cash. The market reaction was modest (+1%). This is a news item, not a stated recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US project sales stall

> *"Vi noterar också att Eolus stiger ungefär 1 %. De gör en mångmiljonaffär i USA"*
